extractor_change_policy: any change to the fn-extraction regex in scripts/mode-a-contract-check.cjs MUST bump EXTRACTOR_VERSION there AND this field AND refresh this census in the same commit (the gate asserts equality - fails closed otherwise). v1 = pub/async-only (R12-E1); v2 = full qualifier space pub(..)? + (const|async|unsafe|extern ".."|bare)* before fn, over-reporting intended (r12-wave-f D-003).
line_count_convention: content.split(\n).length on the raw file bytes (no trim); the script's warn-only line report uses the same expression and reads the frozen figure from frozen_at, never a hardcoded number
registered_legislation: Mode A is a legislated dataplane (ADR-0068 D1/D3), not drift. Boundary law = protocol-family freeze + no TLS fronting + no new L7 features. Trigger line: docs/agents/trigger-line-register.md row 'Mode A shell forwarder boundary law' - net-new dataplane behavior (new handshake dialect / new rewrite rule / new StreamSensor dimension) re-opens adjudication; a deliberate change updates this file in the same commit.
adr_0068_d4_verbatim: HTTPS/TLS fronting of entry ports is explicitly out of scope for this decision.
